problem_statement:
feat(browser): flip WELLS_BROWSER to on by default

browser_* tools are now always registered, matching every other agent
capability (skills, CodeAct, background agents). Playwright itself
still isn't auto-installed -- a call before `pip install
'wells[browser]'` + `playwright install chromium` returns a clear,
actionable error instead of the tool not existing, the same pattern
anthropic/ollama/google provider profiles already use for their own
optional packages. WELLS_BROWSER=0 (or the new /config Setting entry,
picker-driven) opts out entirely for anyone who doesn't want it
offered at all.

Reasoning: the tool was defaulted off to avoid a surprise Chromium
download on every fresh install, but that also buried a capability
most users actually want (interactive/JS-rendered pages, not just
static fetch_url) behind an undiscoverable env var. Flipping the
default keeps the install-cost guarantee (still opt-in, just at the
Playwright-install step instead of the registration step) while making
the capability visible from the start.
